# NEIRO Payment Network

> Solana transactions with gas paid in NEIRO. Independent operators run official Kora, sponsor SOL costs and receive NEIRO reimbursement. Discover operators through SPL Record and call them directly. No router is required.

## Start with the user's task

For “use NEIRO Payment Network,” start with [wallet and app compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network-core/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-NEIRO.md#check-your-wallet-and-app-first), not operator installation. Inspect the existing wallet's sign-only API and the app's instruction/unsigned-transaction builder. Preserve the user authority, set operator fee/rent payers where supported, and verify the completed quote and message. Use existing Solana libraries and plain Kora JSON-RPC; extra SDKs are optional. Verify the completed transaction’s quote after adding reimbursement, correct that instruction and re-quote within bounded retries before signing. Name the actual APIs and test evidence instead of guessing from wallet/app brands. Do not create a replacement wallet or silently spend user SOL.

Operator installation has one canonical guide: [main README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network-core/main/README.md). Follow its nine steps from host/software installation through signer, funding, protected config, HTTPS, publication, supervised renewal, verified discovery and a direct test payment. Run `protect` on the actual private Kora config before public startup. The agent checklist adds verification, not another installer.

## Network

Chain: Solana mainnet-beta
Genesis: 5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdpKuc147dw2N9d
NEIRO mint: CTg3ZgYx79zrE1MteDVkmkcGniiFrK1hJ6yiabropump (6 decimals)
SPL Record program: recr1L3PCGKLbckBqMNcJhuuyU1zgo8nBhfLVsJNwr5
Listing: one account per operator, derived with create_with_seed(operator, "neiro-kora-fees", Record program).
Account size: 733 bytes. Payload marker: NEIRO069 at byte offset 33.

There is no shared master directory account. Scan the Record program with the documented filters, then authenticate the owner, layout, authority and derived address. Listing URLs are untrusted input. Read live SOL balances and obtain quotes directly from selected operators, with bounded concurrency and deadlines. Verify advertised terms, current pricing inputs and the exact transaction before signing. Fastest means first fully verified quote received; cheapest means lowest verified fee among the candidates actually compared. An optional router may assist but is not required or trusted to approve fees.

The runner provides protect, address, check, publish, renew, discover and close. Every operator must use v5 with signed anchor_slot and anchor_blockhash, renew after 24 chain hours, and be rejected at 48 hours from the trusted finalized anchor block time. Reject all older listing versions without fallback. `renew --watch` checks hourly with private persistent state; unchanged terms before 24 hours require no signing or transaction. Stop the sole renewal worker before closure. Do not infer production readiness from a test listing. Close test listings unless the user explicitly requests retention. Skip dead endpoints and reject mismatched terms.

For fast and safe selection, follow the [client selection checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network-core/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-NEIRO.md#fast-verified-operator-selection): batch balances, race a bounded shortlist, independently verify fees before ranking, return the first verified result immediately for fastest, state the comparison scope for cheapest, and reconcile uncertain sends before retrying.

## Signing and operation

The template caps priority fees at 100,000 lamports and checks modeled sponsor outflow and network fees separately against `max_allowed_lamports = 250000000`. Preserve chosen operator overrides, validate the live settings and verify signing rejects above-cap requests. Quotes alone do not enforce admission. Landed failures still cost network fees while the NEIRO reimbursement rolls back; these limits do not guarantee zero losses.

Reuse the user's existing wallet or signer. Show the recipient, asset, amount and total fee before wallet signing. Preserve existing authorizations and spending limits. Keep keys and credentials private. Return finalized transaction receipts; a quote or simulation is not an onchain payment.

Run unchanged Kora and the portable Node.js publisher. Before publishing, deny the operator's derived listing account in every public Kora instance sharing its signer, restart and verify the loaded protection. The publisher requires a compatible raw-message signing backend. Keep an operational listing open; close temporary test listings or retired listings when requested to recover rent.
